title: Arnold--Nielsen Geometry for Complexity-Deformed Noncommutative Transport
summary: We deform the Carlen--Maas--Wirth framework for noncommutative dynamical optimal transport by an Arnold--Nielsen type complexity operator. A positive state-independent operator $G$ compatible with the Hilbert bimodule structure of a noncommutative differential calculus $\partial\colon\M\to\Hcal$ can be absorbed into the calculus itself, \[ \partial_G:=G^{1/2}\partial. \] The corresponding complexity-weighted transport problem is exactly the unweighted transport problem generated by $\partial_G$, whenever the deformed quadratic form remains Dirichlet.
